title: Jeepney drivers vow to continue Tatay Elmer’s fight for good
summary: In this series of interviews, family and friends look back on their fondest memories of the late jeepney driver and activist, sharing how they plan to honor his life

blocks.text: In this series of interviews, family and friends look back on their fondest memories of the late jeepney driver and activist, sharing how they plan to honor his life

MANILA, Philippines – As late jeepney driver and activist “Tatay Elmer” Cordero‘s memorial services come to a close, his peers at Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Opereytor Nationwide (PISTON) have promised to continue the calls for justice that he has long fought for.
Cordero died on October 7 at 78 years old after suffering a heart attack during a protest.
In this series of interviews with Rappler at his cremation on October 14, family and friends look back on their fondest memories of Cordero, sharing how they plan to honor his life. – Rappler.com
